strategy_roster.name: EMA Moving Away
strategy_roster.notes: The documented long threshold is close at least 2% below EMA(55), with return to EMA as exit. Streak and candle-size filters have no documented thresholds and are omitted; 2% is the documented stop.

strategy_roster.name: All Divergences
strategy_roster.entry_long: low < donchian_low_prev(low,2) and roc(rsi(close,14),1) > 0 and close > sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.exit_long: high > donchian_high_prev(high,2) and roc(rsi(close,14),1) < 0 or (close < sma(close,50) and bars_since(close > sma(close,50)) >= 4)
strategy_roster.notes: A new two-bar low with a one-bar-higher RSI proxy retains bullish divergence under SMA(50). The exit combines the mirror divergence with a three-close MA-risk proxy; optional protection has no supplied values.

strategy_roster.name: Dema RSI
strategy_roster.notes: DEMA is approximated by 2*EMA(20)-EMA(EMA(20),20), then RSI(14) crosses its EMA(9) smoother; these lengths are explicit fallbacks because none are documented. Session, point target, and trailing-stop controls are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: R Based Strategy Template
strategy_roster.notes: The long entry follows the documented RSI(14) downward cross below 30. An RSI recross above 50 is an explicit mean-reversion exit proxy; fixed 100-point and ATR protection and 2R sizing are not expressible percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: VoVix DEVMA
strategy_roster.notes: Fast and slow DEVMA are approximated by SMA(20) and SMA(60) of 59-bar standard deviation of ATR; ATR(14) is an explicit fallback. ATR 2x/3x protection is not a fixed percentage field.

strategy_roster.name: DSS Bressert
strategy_roster.notes: A 13-bar range stochastic with one and two EMA(8) smoothings proxies DSS and MIT. The docs repeat the same relation for buy and sell, so the documented DSS-below-MIT cross enters and the opposite cross supplies a distinct long exit; protection is 1%/2%.

strategy_roster.name: Eugene Inside Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A current high above the prior candle high is the fresh-high long breakout, with the mirrored fresh low as exit. The two-bar compression comparison and 08:00 time filter require shifted bars or time fields unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Percentage Crossover Channel System
strategy_roster.entry_long: close <= ema(close,20) * 1.02 and close >= ema(close,20) * 0.98 and bars_since(close > ema(close,20) * 1.02) < 3
strategy_roster.exit_long: close <= ema(close,20) * 1.02 and close >= ema(close,20) * 0.98 and bars_since(close < ema(close,20) * 0.98) < 3
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) with 2% bands is an explicit fallback for the parameterless adaptive channel. The entry and exit retain breakout-then-reentry sequences; price-step protection and the configured historical-band shift are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: RRS Tangled EA
strategy_roster.notes: The source randomly chooses direction and provides no deterministic entry signal, so the impossible negative-price guard prevents fabricating one. Pip targets, trailing, spread limits, order caps, and portfolio risk controls are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Udy Ivan Madumere
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(open,4)>0 is a rolling proxy for the positive difference between opens two and six bars apart; the inverse exits. The 18:00 once-daily gate, point thresholds, asymmetric protection, short trailing stop, and holding timer are unavailable.
